note: MOCK data for development. Not real SPHEREx measurements.

targets.name: (4) Vesta
targets.description: Bright main-belt asteroid. Moves visibly between SPHEREx exposures taken hours apart. Mock positions are illustrative, not an ephemeris.
targets.validation_note: Real SPHEREx images found with an ephemeris check (JPL Horizons vs footprints): 160 independent exposures; on 2026-07-13 it moves ~124" (~20 px) in 3.2 h.

real_view.source: JPL Horizons ephemeris + SPHEREx QR3 footprint check (exposures 2026W29_1A_0138_4 and 2026W29_1A_0163_1)

targets.name: 12P/Pons-Brooks
targets.description: Periodic comet; diffuse coma, slower apparent motion than the asteroid. Mock positions are illustrative, not an ephemeris.
targets.validation_note: Ephemeris check: SPHEREx footprints cover it in 172 exposures, but it is V ~19.7-23.8 in 2025-26, probably too faint to see in single images.

targets.name: 3I/ATLAS (C/2025 N1)
targets.description: Third known interstellar object, passing through the Solar System in 2025-26. Mock track uses its real position and rate on 2025-12-08 (JPL Horizons); images are synthetic in mock mode.
targets.validation_note: Known Moving Object Demo, not a discovery. Seen in all 23 real DR1 images of 2025-12-08 (00:11-03:30 UTC, D1 and D4): a bright source within 1 pixel of the JPL Horizons position in every frame, and gone from its earlier positions. Extended coma: no point-source photometry.

real_view.source: JPL Horizons ephemeris + SPHEREx DR1 footprint check (exposures 2025W50_1A_0002_1..4 and 2025W50_1A_0021_1)

targets.name: WISE J085510.83-071442.5
targets.description: Coldest known brown dwarf (~250 K). Proper motion ~8 arcsec/yr, i.e. about 1 SPHEREx pixel per year: barely visible between 6-month visits.

catalog_motion.source_catalog: published infrared astrometry (pmRA -8.119, pmDec +0.680 arcsec/yr); not in Gaia DR3. Parallax (~0.4 arcsec) not applied, below the 6.15 arcsec pixel

targets.validation_note: Real images exist; detection in a single frame is not guaranteed (very faint below ~3 um). Motion ~8"/yr is about 1 pixel per year.

targets.name: Barnard's Star (GJ 699)
targets.description: Highest proper-motion star (~10.4 arcsec/yr). Still under 1 SPHEREx pixel per 6 months.

catalog_motion.source_catalog: Gaia DR3 4472832130942575872 (queried via IRSA TAP); errors ~0.03 mas/yr

targets.validation_note: Centred in 4 real SPHEREx visits after proper-motion propagation; difference images show its northward sub-pixel shift.

targets.name: Mira (o Ceti)
targets.description: Long-period variable (~332 d). Position fixed; the change over time is brightness.
targets.validation_note: Seen in 3 real visits; the saturated core's glow grows and shrinks between them. Gaia DR3 has no proper motion for it (too bright), so none is applied.
